# PipeFish Labs

> PipeFish Labs is an enterprise AI automation agency specializing in autonomous multi-agent orchestration, Native Mistral Handoffs, Managed MCP Connectors, zero-trust security architecture, post-quantum cryptography, scalable data pipelines, and management consulting.

## Core Offerings

- [Services & Solutions](https://pipefishlabs.io/services-solutions/): Full catalog of 20+ specialized AI automation, security, and consulting services.
- [Live Interactive Simulator](https://pipefishlabs.io/demo/): Interactive 8-node agent chain execution graph demonstrating real-time HMAC-signed state handoffs.
- [Case Studies & Results](https://pipefishlabs.io/case-studies-results/): Documented ROI including 78% reduction in order fulfillment delays for global logistics networks.
- [Benefits & Testimonials](https://pipefishlabs.io/benefits-testimonials/): Client verification metrics (Angela L. CFO HonuEco, Michael J. CEO Lubrexx, John S. CEO Omnium International).
- [Engineering Blog](https://pipefishlabs.io/blog/): Deep-dive papers on multi-agent DAG graphs, NIST post-quantum cryptography (Kyber / Dilithium), and EU AI Act Annex IV conformity.

## Technical Architecture

- **Multi-Agent Orchestration**: Asynchronous DAG state handoffs passing cryptographically signed JSON payloads across CRM, EMR, ERP, Phone, Email, and custom MCP servers.
- **Native Mistral Handoffs**: Tool-call state persistence across agent chains enabling seamless inter-agent communication with cryptographic payload signing.
- **Managed MCP Connectors**: Pre-built, security-audited Model Context Protocol connectors for CRM, EMR, ERP, Phone, Email, and custom enterprise integrations.
- **Code Interpreter**: On-demand sandboxed code execution environment for dynamic computation within agent workflows.
- **Document Library RAG**: Retrieval-augmented generation over enterprise document libraries for context-aware agent responses.
- **Zero-Trust Security**: mTLS identity, automated secret rotation via HashiCorp Vault, eBPF Falco threat IDS, and zero-data-retention AI enclaves.
- **Post-Quantum Cryptography**: Production-ready NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM-768) and FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) key encapsulation and digital signatures.
- **Compliance**: EU AI Act Annex IV conformity, automated explainability audit logs, and human-in-the-loop override controls.

## Python SDK

- [`sdk/pipefish_sdk.py`](https://github.com/donny-devops/pipefish-labs/blob/main/sdk/pipefish_sdk.py): Python SDK (v2.4.0) for programmatic access to the PipeFish Labs autonomous multi-agent orchestration platform. Supports Native Mistral Handoffs, Managed MCP Connectors, and ZDR Confidential Enclave State Sync.

## CI/CD Security Pipeline

- **CodeQL**: Semantic static analysis and vulnerability scanning on every push and pull request.
- **Gitleaks Secret Scanning**: Continuous detection of hardcoded secrets, API keys, and credentials across all commits.
- **SLSA Provenance**: OpenSSF SLSA Level 3 supply-chain integrity verification via `generator-generic-ossf-slsa3-publish.yml`.
- **DOM Integrity**: Automated DOM structure validation for the platform landing page via `verify-dom.yml`.
